prompt:
Research the current official API prices of DeepSeek's models (per million input and output tokens, including cache-hit pricing). Cite DeepSeek's own pricing page and quote the prices.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the search results, I found the official DeepSeek API pricing information. Here are the current prices for DeepSeek's models:

**Current DeepSeek API Pricing (per 1 million tokens):**

**DeepSeek-Flash Model:**
- **Cache Hit Input Tokens:** $0.003 (off-peak), $0.006 (peak)
- **Cache Miss Input Tokens:** $0.15 (off-peak), $0.30 (peak)  
- **Output Tokens:** $0.60 (off-peak), $1.20 (peak)

**DeepSeek-V4-Pro Model:**
- **Cache Hit Input Tokens:** $0.022 (off-peak), $0.044 (peak)
- **Cache Miss Input Tokens:** $0.66 (off-peak), $1.32 (peak)
- **Output Tokens:** $1.98 (off-peak), $3.96 (peak)

**Source verification lines:**

SOURCE: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing | QUOTE: "1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE HIT) | OFF-PEAK | $0.003 | PEAK | $0.006" | CLAIM: DeepSeek-Flash cache hit input token pricing
SOURCE: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing | QUOTE: "1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE MISS) | OFF-PEAK | $0.15 | PEAK | $0.3" | CLAIM: DeepSeek-Flash cache miss input token pricing
SOURCE: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing | QUOTE: "1M OUTPUT TOKENS | OFF-PEAK | $0.6 | PEAK | $1.2" | CLAIM: DeepSeek-Flash output token pricing
SOURCE: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing | QUOTE: "1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE HIT) | OFF-PEAK | $0.022 | PEAK | $0.044" | CLAIM: DeepSeek-V4-Pro cache hit input token pricing
SOURCE: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing | QUOTE: "1M INPUT TOKENS (CACHE MISS) | OFF-PEAK | $0.66 | PEAK | $1.32" | CLAIM: DeepSeek-V4-Pro cache miss input token pricing
SOURCE: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing | QUOTE: "1M OUTPUT TOKENS | OFF-PEAK | $1.98 | PEAK | $3.96" | CLAIM: DeepSeek-V4-Pro output token pricing
SOURCE: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing | QUOTE: "Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday (all other hours are off-peak)." | CLAIM: Definition of peak and off-peak hours
